title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote

The Team + The Role

Pendo's Product Marketing team translates what we build into why it matters. The team works at the intersection of product, revenue, and marketing, owning the narratives, positioning, and go-to-market motions that drive pipeline and commercial outcomes. It operates as a small, senior team with high ownership, low overhead, and a strong bias toward work that moves the business forward.

Pendo is looking for a Sr. Product Marketing Manager to play a key role in our growing Enterprise business. You will partner closely across Product, Sales, and Marketing to package and position Pendo's offerings as powerful solutions for Enterprise clients. This is an individual contributor role for a builder who can create, test, adapt, and make an immediate impact in a fast-moving, AI-native environment.

This is a remote role in the United States. We have offices in San Francisco, CA, Raleigh, NC, or New York, NY.

What this looks like day-to-day

  • Enterprise positioning: Own and maintain clear, concise, and impactful solutions messaging for the Enterprise market. Translate Pendo's product capabilities into value-driven narratives that resonate with Enterprise buyers.
  • Cross-functional partnership: Collaborate strategically with Product, PMM, Sales, and Marketing teams to package and position Pendo's offerings for Enterprise clients. Serve as a key conduit between Enterprise go-to-market teams and Product by bringing field feedback into product conversations.
  • Flexible execution: Move fluidly across adjacent work as priorities shift, including solutions marketing, growth-hacker-style experiments, and demand-gen support. Adapt quickly rather than staying in a single fixed lane.
  • AI-enabled GTM: Leverage AI tools and workflows, including building agents, to accelerate research, content creation, and go-to-market execution. Use AI as a practical multiplier for how you work and what you ship.
  • Market research: Conduct in-depth research to define, understand, and articulate the distinct needs and opportunities within the Enterprise landscape for Pendo. Use that insight to shape messaging, campaign direction, and sales conversations.
  • Sales partnership: Forge strong partnerships with the Enterprise Sales team to understand their requirements, challenges, and revenue opportunities. Participate in strategic Enterprise deals by providing product and solutions expertise.
  • Testing and iteration: Rapidly test, learn, and adapt messaging and campaigns in a fast-changing environment. Use feedback from the market, Sales, and Product to improve the work quickly.
  • Enterprise content: Develop compelling content and collateral for Enterprise audiences, including presentations, white papers, and case studies. Ensure materials are clear, persuasive, and aligned to the needs of Enterprise buyers.
  • Enterprise strategy support: Elevate and accelerate Pendo's overall Enterprise marketing strategy and execution. Contribute strategically to competitive intelligence, pricing considerations, and enablement programs tailored for the Enterprise market.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Sr. Product Marketing Managers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

  • A proven track record of building and shipping product marketing work, with depth of ownership that matters more than the number of years in seat.
  • Experience creating, testing, and adapting product marketing work in fast-moving, high-growth, startup, or similarly ambiguous environments.
  • AI fluency, including comfort working in an AI-shaped environment and using AI tools or workflows to improve research, content creation, and execution.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguity, move across shifting priorities, and flex into adjacent areas such as solutions marketing, growth, and demand generation.
  • Exceptional ability to translate technical product features into compelling, value-driven solutions for buyers.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting market research, competitive analysis, and developing targeted messaging.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively across Product, Sales, and Marketing teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and persuasively.
  • Ability to travel occasionally.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience building AI agents or workflows to accelerate product marketing or go-to-market work.
  • Experience supporting Enterprise marketing, Enterprise sales motions, or strategic Enterprise deals.
  • Experience contributing to competitive intelligence, pricing considerations, or enablement programs tailored for Enterprise markets.

title: Senior Benefits Administrator
description:
Headquarters: United States - Remote

Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com, @patientpop.com, or @kareo.com) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and analytical Senior Benefits Administrator to oversee the day-to-day administration and strategic alignment of our health and welfare plans. Reporting directly to the HR Operations Director, this role plays a pivotal part in managing our self-insured medical plan, monitoring plan performance, managing Third-Party Administrator (TPA) relationships, and ensuring compliance across all health and welfare offerings (medical, dental, vision, life, disability, 401K and wellness).

The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in ERISA, HIPAA, and ACA compliance, strong data analytics capabilities to evaluate claim trends, and exceptional employee communication skills to deliver a seamless experience.

Your Area of Focus

Self-Insured Plan Oversight & Financial Management

  • Claims Analysis & Tracking: Monitor ongoing medical and prescription drug claims performance; identify trends, high-cost claimants, and cost-driver patterns in partnership with plan actuaries and brokers.
  • Stop-Loss Administration: Coordinate stop-loss policy renewals, track claims reaching individual/aggregate stop-loss thresholds, and submit reimbursement filings to carriers.
  • TPA & Vendor Governance: Oversee relationships with Third-Party Administrators (TPAs), Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs), and Benefits broker and carriers. Ensure operational execution according to SLAs.
  • Funding & Reconciliations: Partner with Payroll and Accounting to manage weekly/monthly billing, claims funding requests, reserve requirements (IBNR tracking), and employee contribution and invoice reconciliations.

Health & Welfare Plan Administration

  • Open Enrollment: Lead the annual Open Enrollment process, including system updates, open enrollment communications, employee informational sessions, and post-enrollment audits.
  • Life Events & Ongoing Administration: Manage day-to-day enrollment changes, qualifying life events (QLEs), dependent eligibility verifications, and COBRA processing.
  • Disability & Leave Coordination: Support short-term/long-term disability programs and align benefit premiums during active FMLA/LOA periods.

Compliance & Governance

  • Regulatory Reporting: Ensure strict compliance with federal and state regulations, including ERISA, ACA (1094/1095 reporting), HIPAA, COBRA, and FMLA.
  • Plan Documentation: Maintain updated Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs), Summaries of Benefits and Coverage (SBCs), Plan Documents, and Form 5500 filings.
  • Nondiscrimination Testing: Coordinate annual 105(h) and Section 125 nondiscrimination testing with third-party compliance specialists.
  • Annual Benefits Audits: Lead annual 401K audit and execute dependent eligibility and enrollment audits throughout the year.

Employee Experience & Communications

  • Escalated Claims Support: Act as the primary point of contact for complex, escalated employee claims issues, serving as an advocate while maintaining plan governance.
  • Benefits Communication: Draft clear, accessible employee communications explaining self-insured plan features, cost-saving tools (e.g., telehealth, centers of excellence), and wellness incentive initiatives.

Your Professional Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 5 years of direct experience dedicated to health & welfare plan administration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing self-insured / self-funded medical plans, including working with stop-loss insurance, TPAs, and PBMs.
  • Professional Certifications (Preferred): CEBS (Certified Employee Benefit Specialist), SHRM-CP/SHRM-SCP, or PHR/SPHR.

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • HRIS Proficiency: Experience administering benefits using Workday.
  • Data & Excel Mastery: Advanced skills in MS Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data modeling) to analyze large sets of claims and census data.
  • Regulatory Depth: Deep functional knowledge of ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, COBRA, and IRS Section 125 rules.

title: Brand Designer
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. Our database platform offers developers the fastest and most reliable Postgres and Vitess/MySQL databases, enabling businesses to efficiently handle data and workloads of all sizes.

PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher.

We're looking for a Brand Designer to help shape and evolve the visual identity of PlanetScale across all touchpoints. In this role, you'll be a key member of our Marketing team, translating complex technical concepts into compelling visual stories that resonate with developers and technical decision-makers. You'll craft everything from in-person event experiences to web graphics, merch designs, and creative website assets that make databases feel exciting.

What's the job to be done?

Visual Brand Development

  • Design web graphics including technical diagrams, illustrations, and interactive visual assets that simplify complex database concepts.
  • Create compelling visual systems for campaigns, product launches, and marketing initiatives.
  • Design for multiple formats and contexts: digital, print, experiential, and merchandise.

In-Person Experiences

  • Design booth graphics, signage, and environmental branding for conferences, meetups, and community events.
  • Collaborate with the events team to create memorable, on-brand experiences that stand out
  • Design merch that developers actually want to wear and use.
  • Create branded collateral including banners, posters, stickers, and promotional materials.

Website and Digital Assets

  • Design creative website components and landing pages.
  • Design data visualizations and technical diagrams that make complex information accessible.
  • Create social media graphics, blog post imagery, and other digital marketing assets.
  • Develop templates and design systems that enable the team to move quickly.

Brand Evolution

  • Collaborate with marketing leadership to evolve and expand the PlanetScale brand identity.
  • Explore new visual directions while maintaining brand coherence.
  • Document design decisions and maintain brand guidelines.

These attributes best describe you.

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating versatile design skills across digital, print, and experiential design.
  • Deep understanding of design fundamentals: typography, color, composition, and visual hierarchy.
  • You've figured out where AI actually helps in a design workflow and built process around it.
  • Comfortable working in both brand and production modes. You can think big picture and execute in the details.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to both articulate design decisions and understand direction.
  • Self-directed and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines.
  • Collaborative spirit with the ability to incorporate feedback while maintaining creative vision.

What else will help you be successful.

  • Experience designing for technical or developer-focused brands.
  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and other design tools.
  • Comfortable using AI to build a working first draft of a page rather than handing off a static mockup.
  • Understanding of design systems and component-based thinking.
  • Enthusiasm for learning about databases, infrastructure, and developer tools.

Why PlanetScale

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Brand Designer, you'll help shape how developers and engineering leaders perceive and interact with PlanetScale, translating the power of our platform into visual experiences that inspire and inform. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

Total Compensation and Pay Transparency

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

Base salary range: $170,000 - $220,000 USD

Atomic Flooring / Atomic Construction

·       Help manage our Facebook and Instagram accounts and maintain a consistent posting schedule.

·       Develop creative ideas for showcasing our work and attracting new customers.

·       Repurpose existing photos and videos into multiple pieces of marketing content.

·       Monitor engagement and recommend ways to improve content and reach.

Customer Service & Lead Management

·       Respond promptly to incoming leads from our website, social media, text messages, and other sources.

·       Communicate professionally with potential customers by text, phone, email, and messaging apps.

·       Follow up with prospects who have requested information or estimates.

·       Ask basic questions about customers’ flooring projects and gather information our sales team needs.

·       Schedule estimates and appointments for our team.

·       Keep customer information and follow-up activities organized.

·       Provide a friendly, professional customer experience that reflects our company well.

Administrative & Marketing Support

·       Assist with promotions, marketing campaigns, and business development.

·       Help organize leads, appointments, and customer communications.

·       Research marketing ideas, trends, and opportunities.

·       Assist with administrative tasks as our business grows.

·       Take initiative and help improve our marketing and customer service processes.

Qualifications

Required

·       Excellent written and spoken English.

·       Strong communication and customer service skills, including a professional phone manner.

·       Reliable internet connection and a suitable computer.

·       Good organizational skills and attention to detail.

·       Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and learn new tools.

·       Availability during agreed-upon hours that overlap with Arizona business hours.

Strongly preferred

·       Fluency in both English and Spanish.

·       Experience creating social media content for businesses.

·       Experience editing short videos for Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, or TikTok.

·       Familiarity with Canva and video editing tools such as CapCut.

·       Experience managing Facebook and Instagram business accounts.

·       Experience handling sales inquiries, following up with leads, and booking appointments.

·       Experience working with U.S. businesses.

The Ideal Candidate

We want someone who is creative, proactive, dependable, and comfortable wearing several hats. You should be able to take a few photos or short video clips we send you and turn them into polished, professional content that captures a potential customer’s attention. You should also be comfortable communicating with customers, responding to inquiries quickly, and helping turn incoming leads into scheduled estimates. We value people who take ownership of their work, suggest improvements, and want to grow with the business.

Compensation & Schedule

title: Area Vice President, West/South Central
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

About the Role

Cybercrime doesn't wait for anyone to catch up to it, and neither do we. As a second-line sales leader reporting to the VP of Enterprise Sales, you'll own the sales teams across your defined area, overseeing multiple frontline Sales Leaders and their teams, with a mandate to overachieve new annual recurring revenue quota for the region, not just meet it.

You'll be leading through one of the more exciting stretches in the company's history: we're growing 40%+ year over year, protecting more than 4,500 customers including over 25% of the Fortune 500, and expanding fast from email into identity, AI security, and insider threat. That means your teams have more surface area to sell, more room to build, and more impact to make than they would leading an area at a mature market leader.

What You Will Do

  • Work with your leaders and their teams to run the full deal cycle on named enterprise accounts (>3k mailbox organizations): first conversation, contract signature, and the upsell conversations that follow once they're a customer.
  • Recruit and hire a world-class team of enterprise sellers and leaders, on time and on budget, meeting the area's projected productive capacity and building a bench of future candidate relationships so you're never caught flat-footed by team changes.
  • Set clear productivity metrics and growth milestones for your leaders and sellers, and enable them to consistently hit them.
  • Instill a disciplined approach to pipeline generation, activating every resource available: field sales, marketing, channel partners, and sales development, to accelerate new business.
  • Build the sales execution strategy for your area and drive the execution and collaborative team selling that brings it to life.
  • Lead a data-driven business that develops each Leader and Account Executive in the areas that matter most for their skillset and their NARR results.

title: Client Director - Financial Services
description:
Headquarters: Remote, US, New York

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

The Client Director is a senior member of our sales organization, responsible for the long-arc commercial trajectory of Celonis’s most strategically important accounts. You sit at the intersection of enterprise sales leadership and platform strategy—owning a focused portfolio of one to few large accounts generating significant ARR, and working in close partnership with Value Engineers, Client Value Partners (CVP), and Professional Services to grow, protect, and compound that revenue over multi-year horizons.

The Role

As the Client Director of our Financial Services accounts, your primary objective is to develop, maintain, and expand resilient sponsorship and sticky business critical use cases across the client’s business. You are accountable for moving accounts from solving individual pain points to an Enterprise AI platform of record—embedding the Celonis platform as a strategic pillar within the client’s operations.

You are the client’s most senior commercial partner, engaging at the C-suite level on business strategy, platform investment, and multi-year transformation. Where a CVP is deployed, you own the commercial relationship and expansion strategy; they own value realization and adoption.

The work you’ll do

  • Own the commercial relationship: Serve as the primary executive point of contact across the C-suite—CEO, CFO, CSCO, COO, CIO—building relationships that transcend any individual deal cycle and anchor Celonis to the customer’s long-term strategic agenda.
  • Drive ARR and NRR growth: Develop and execute a structured expansion roadmap—identifying new business units, geographies, use cases, and platform capabilities that compound ARR over time. Lead commercial negotiations for expansions, renewals, and multi-year enterprise agreements in partnership with Deal Desk and Legal.
  • Translate adoption into commercial momentum: Partner with the CVP and Value Engineering teams to convert adoption milestones and realized value into renewal confidence and expansion urgency. Own executive business reviews that are forward-looking and commercially anchored.
  • Embed Celonis as a strategic platform: Position Celonis within the customer's AI strategy—connecting Process Intelligence to their LLM, automation, and agentic AI investments so the platform becomes a foundational data and orchestration layer, not a point solution.
  • Protect through transformation: Proactively identify and mitigate commercial risk: sponsor departures, competitive displacement, implementation fatigue, and budget consolidation. Ensure multi-threaded executive relationships and a documented value story that survives the leadership transitions common in large enterprise accounts.
  • Scale the practice: Codify account strategies, expansion motions, and transformation navigation approaches into reusable assets for the broader Strategic Accounts practice. Maintain disciplined account plan, pipeline strategy and coverage to any growth targets, and forecast accuracy across a small, complex account set.

The qualifications you need

  • 12+ years in enterprise SaaS sales or strategic account management, with at least 5 years managing accounts with $5M+ ARR.
  • Deep industry expertise in Financial Services— with the credibility to engage customers on industry-specific challenges, benchmarks, and transformation priorities, not just platform capabilities.
  • Preferred direct experience with large financial institutions leading transformation initiatives or acting as a strategic consultant or Client Director.
  • Demonstrated track record of growing ARR within named accounts over multi-year horizons—expanding platform footprint, not just renewing contracts.
  • Executive presence and credibility at the C-suite level—able to lead strategic conversations with CFOs, COOs, and CIOs and influence large, complex buying decisions.
  • Experience navigating enterprise transformations—ERP consolidations, cloud migrations, M&A, organizational restructuring—without losing commercial momentum.
  • Fluent in business case construction: ROI modeling, TCO analysis, and value benchmarking at a level that withstands CFO scrutiny.
  • Comfortable with long deal cycles and ambiguity; skilled at managing internal and external stakeholders across 12–24+ month expansion arcs.
  • Background in ERP, Supply Chain, Finance transformation, or AI-native enterprise platforms strongly preferred; familiarity with agentic AI, automation, or intelligent process orchestration a plus.
  • Proven ability to work in a team-selling model alongside value engineering, professional services, partners, and extended GTM teams like Growth, Industry, and Transformation experts.
This role will be expected to spend the majority of their time in the field meeting with clients.

Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.

Total compensation package will include base salary + bonus/commission + equity + benefits (health, dental, life, 401k, and paid time off). $211,000—$250,000 USD

  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. title: 70-100K Potential for Practice Growth Advisor Sales Position  (Central or Eastern Time Zone)
description:
Headquarters: Southern California
URL: https://ucmpracticegrowthsystems.com/

Summary

NOTE: Applicants MUST read this entire job posting and complete all steps outlined below to be considered for this position.

Our Mission

At UCM Practice Growth Systems, we're a team on a mission. Dedicated to the glory of God, we aim to bring hope and healing to sick and suffering people through our partnership with upper cervical chiropractors.

We help chiropractic practices grow with proven patient acquisition systems, training and business growth consulting that let doctors focus on what matters most: helping more patients.

We're looking for a driven, relationship-oriented sales professional who shares our passion for helping doctors grow their practices and is excited about the opportunity to build meaningful relationships while generating new business.

Your Role in Our Mission

As a Practice Growth Advisor, your primary responsibility is to generate new revenue by identifying, engaging, and converting qualified upper cervical chiropractic practices into UCM clients.

This results-driven sales position requires someone who can confidently prospect, build relationships, conduct effective sales consultations, and close new business.

You won't simply wait for leads to come to you. You'll take ownership of developing your own pipeline (we provide the leads for you), creating sales opportunities, and consistently turning qualified conversations into new clients.

We believe great salespeople don't pressure prospects into buying. They identify real needs, build trust, provide valuable solutions, and guide prospects toward decisions that help their businesses succeed.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position means consistently generating new business, maintaining a healthy sales pipeline, and converting qualified opportunities into paying clients.

New deals may include Practice Growth Memberships, Associate Recruitment Programs, Start Right Programs, website designs, and other UCM solutions.

A successful Practice Growth Advisor consistently closes 5 or more new deals per month, maintains a 40% conversion rate on qualified sales consultations, schedules at least 13 qualified outbound appointments, and successfully completes at least 12 of those appointments each month.

Your Key Responsibilities

  1. New Revenue Generation
    Consistently generate new business by identifying qualified prospects, conducting sales consultations, and closing deals to achieve monthly revenue and sales goals.

  2. Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation
    Proactively identify and engage potential clients through touchpoints; phone calls, texts, emails, social media messages, and other outreach strategies to build a consistent flow of qualified opportunities.  PGA’s that consistently achieve 500 touchpoints per week get the best results.

  3. Sales Pipeline Management
    Take full ownership of your sales pipeline by tracking prospects, maintaining accurate CRM records, scheduling follow-ups, and moving opportunities efficiently through the sales process. 

  4. Consultative Selling & Closing
    Build trust with prospective clients, identify their business challenges, recommend appropriate solutions, overcome objections, and confidently convert qualified opportunities into new clients.

  5. Product & Service Expertise
    Develop a thorough understanding of UCM's growth memberships, products, services and pricing to effectively communicate their value and recommend solutions that align with each practice's needs.

  6. Sales Performance & Accountability
    Consistently meet or exceed established KPIs, including new deals closed, consultation conversion rates, qualified appointments scheduled, and appointments completed.

  7. Relationship Building & Brand Representation
    Establish meaningful relationships with chiropractic professionals while representing UCM's mission, core values, and commitment to ethical, relationship-based selling.

  8. Industry Events & Networking
    Represent UCM at chiropractic conferences, college events, and industry gatherings to develop relationships, generate new opportunities, and expand the company's reach when needed.

  9. Sales Training & Continuous Improvement
    Participate in sales role play coaching, call reviews, and professional development to continuously improve prospecting effectiveness, objection handling, and closing performance.

What We're Looking For

Sales Experience and Skills

  • Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or consultative selling.

  • Demonstrated success generating appointments through outbound prospecting.

  • Strong ability to build rapport and establish trust with business owners or decision-makers.

  • Experience conducting qualifying calls, demo consultations, and closing conversations.

  • Confidence in overcoming objections and guiding prospects through purchasing decisions.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Experience using CRM systems to manage leads, track activity, and maintain an organized pipeline.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize opportunities, and consistently achieve measurable sales goals.

Personal Characteristics

  • Self-motivated: You take initiative and don't need constant supervision to generate opportunities.

  • Results-oriented: You enjoy working toward clear performance goals and being accountable for measurable outcomes.

  • Relationship-focused: You genuinely care about understanding people and helping them succeed.

  • Persistent: You understand that successful sales require consistent outreach, follow-up, and resilience.

  • Coachable: You welcome feedback, embrace training, and continuously improve your approach.

  • Organized: You take pride in maintaining accurate records, reporting results daily and following through on commitments.

  • Mission-aligned: You're excited about helping chiropractic practices grow so they can serve more patients.

Compensation 

We offer a performance-based compensation structure that rewards successful business development and sales results.

First 90 Days – Paid Training and Performance Period

  • $3,000 monthly base compensation.

  • 20% commission on deals personally generated and closed.

  • Structured training and guidance from our Director of Sales.

  • Opportunity to demonstrate sales ability, master our services, and build a productive pipeline.

After 90 Days – Base + Commission

Upon successfully completing the initial performance period:

  • $1,500 monthly base compensation.

  • 50% commission on first-month membership revenue for eligible sales.

  • 25% commission on eligible one-time purchases.

  • Significant earnings potential based on individual sales performance with our sales career path.

The initial 90-day evaluation includes successfully learning UCM's offerings, independently sourcing opportunities, closing at least 5 personally generated deals, maintaining accurate CRM records, and demonstrating alignment with company standards.

Benefits

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership advancement.

  • Company-sponsored professional and personal development training.

  • 50% contribution toward an eligible major medical insurance policy premium.

  • 100% reimbursement for eligible upper cervical chiropractic care after 90 days.

  • Company-paid travel expenses for approved business events.

  • Paid time off after 90 days, subject to company PTO policy.

  • Complimentary Financial Peace University participation after 180 days.

  • Eligibility for monthly profit sharing bonuses after 365 days.

  • 401(k) with a 4% company match after 365 days.

Employment, Payroll, and Work-Location Requirements

Applicants must be eligible to be employed directly through UCM Practice Growth Systems’ existing U.S. payroll and benefits programs.

UCM Practice Growth Systems is unable to:

  • Sponsor employment visas or work authorization.

  • Establish foreign payroll or a foreign legal entity.

  • Hire through an international employer-of-record service.

  • Provide country-specific benefits, tax administration, or employment arrangements.

  • Make exceptions to the eligibility requirements established by our payroll and benefits providers.

Candidates residing outside the United States must be legally permitted to work from their country of residence and must disclose their country and region of residence during the application process. Employment is contingent upon confirmation that the candidate’s location is supported by the company’s payroll, insurance, benefits, and employment arrangements.

Applicants must also be consistently available during Central or Eastern Time Zone business hours.

Flexible Hours:
Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday 8 AM to 5 PM Eastern time or 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern time & Tuesdays  9:30 AM to 6:30 PM Eastern time. 60-minute lunch each day.

title: Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work. 

Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless.  That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses.

We’re builders at heart, and we’re looking for builders who want to expand what’s possible in Airtable and what the world can build with it.

As a Sales Manager for Strategic Accounts, you’ll own the performance of a team selling into some of the world’s largest organizations. You’ll be responsible for delivering ambitious revenue goals, hiring and developing exceptional Account Executives, and getting directly involved in the accounts and deals where your judgment and experience can make a difference.

If you’re excited by the challenge of building a high-performing team while staying close to the business, you’ll thrive here. You’ll be a trusted partner to senior customer executives, help your team navigate its most important opportunities, and work across Airtable to turn what you learn from customers into better ways of selling, operating, and ultimately serving them.

What you'll do

  • Own your team’s revenue performance, setting ambitious goals and creating the focus, accountability, and operating rhythm needed to deliver against them.
  • Build and develop an exceptional team of Strategic Account Executives through thoughtful hiring, hands-on coaching, and regular, actionable feedback.
  • Stay close to your most important accounts and opportunities, helping shape deal and account strategy and building trusted relationships with senior customer executives.
  • Own forecasting and planning for your business, bringing rigor to pipeline management and using data and judgment to identify where your team needs to focus.
  • Partner across Sales, Customer Success, Solution Engineering, Product, and other teams to remove barriers, surface customer needs, and improve how we serve and sell to our largest customers.
  • Help shape the way the Strategic Sales organization operates, identifying opportunities to improve the structures, processes, and ways of working that enable the team to scale.

Who you are

  • You bring 8+ years of quota-carrying sales experience in technology, ideally SaaS, with a strong track record of selling to and closing large enterprise accounts.
  • You have people management experience and a track record of building and leading high-performing sales teams.
  • You’re an exceptional coach. You can diagnose what’s holding a seller or deal back, give clear and actionable feedback, and adapt your approach to help different people perform at their best.
  • You have strong commercial judgment. You know when to go deep on a deal, when to challenge your team’s thinking, and when to bring in the right stakeholders to change the trajectory of an opportunity.
  • You combine strategic thinking with operational rigor. You can see the bigger picture while staying close to pipeline, forecasting, account strategy, and the details that ultimately drive performance.
  • You’re a strong communicator and relationship builder. You can earn credibility with senior customer executives, create alignment across internal teams, and communicate clearly when priorities or perspectives differ.

What we offer

Compensation awarded to successful candidates will vary based on their work location, relevant skills and experience. 

For work locations in the San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, Los Angeles, and New York, the on-target earnings range for this role is $320,000 - $430,000 USD. For all other work locations (including remote), the range is $288,000 – $400,000 USD.

We care deeply about craft, think strategically about systems, and move fast when the moment calls for it.

In this role you'll work closely with a team of brand designers and design ops, collaborate cross-functionally with PMM, Product Design, Web, and Social, and partner with external agencies on bigger productions. You'll help define how Zapier moves across every surface, and build the systems and tooling that let the whole org ship motion work independently without Brand Studio in the room every time.If you want to advance your career at a fast-growing, profitable, impact-driven company, read on…

  • Our Commitment to Applicants

  • Culture and Values at Zapier

  • Zapier Guide to Remote Work

  • Zapier Code of Conduct

  • Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier

 

About You

  • You can take a UI frame or a brand brief and turn it into a story that lands. You ask the right questions, understand the product well enough to know what the animation needs to communicate, and don't wait for a fully baked storyboard to get started

  • You think in systems. You build mogrts files, component libraries, and motion guidelines that other people can use independently, and every project is an opportunity to make the next one ship faster

  • You understand brand as well as UI: timing, easing, personality, the emotional register that makes motion feel ownable rather than generic

  • You have a strong sense of sound and rhythm. You know how motion and sound work together, and you shape that relationship intentionally rather than as an afterthought

  • You understand narrative. You think about motion the way a director thinks about a scene: setup, tension, resolution. You know when to breathe and when to accelerate, and you can articulate that thinking to stakeholders

  • You manage up with creative insight, bringing your expertise into conversations proactively so stakeholders understand the why behind every creative choice

  • You use AI as a genuine part of your practice, experimenting with video tools and sharing what you figure out so the whole team benefits

  • You're energized by ambiguity, move fast, and don't wait for perfect conditions

     

Things You’ll Do:

  • Design and produce motion across product explainers, website animations, paid social video snippets, keynote and event motion, and campaign assets

  • Draft simple storyboards yourself for straightforward projects so we can move fast without a separate brief-to-board cycle

  • Work directly from UI frames provided by the product team to build polished product demo animations and feature explainers

  • Build Zapier's motion design language: ownable branded motion patterns that establish how Zapier feels in motion across every surface

  • Create motion guidelines, component libraries, and mogrts files that give partners and social teams repeatable building blocks to work from independently

  • Explore tools like Jitter and Figma Motion to enable partners to generate on-brand animated assets without Brand Studio involvement every time

  • Produce short video snippets for paid social testing across multiple angles and formats

  • Support the recurring product video format and turn it into a scalable template for future launches

We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

title: Category Manager

Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.

StockX has redefined the global marketplace for culture — where buyers and sellers transact with confidence on an always-on digital exchange. We are building the next frontier of creator-driven, culturally rich commerce that blends excitement, community, expertise, and transaction in one platform.

This initiative is designed to empower sellers and creators to build sustainable businesses while creating moments that drive deep engagement. To support this effort, we are forming a category-led Go-To-Market organization that scales with culture, category dynamics, and community expertise.

The Category Manager is a foundational hire tasked with owning the growth and strategic trajectory of a major category. You will serve as the chief operator, strategist, and market voice for your category — identifying opportunity, building pipelines, and driving seller and creator engagement from early stages through scale.

This role blends strategic planning, deep customer and market understanding, and hands-on execution, with full ownership of category growth outcomes. What You’ll Do

  • Become a deep expert on the category’s supply landscape, demand drivers, community channels, and competitive dynamics
  • Establish metrics and quarterly goals to measure and drive category performance

Supply & Community Acquisition

  • Build a robust pipeline of sellers, creators, influencers, and shops within your category
  • Drive outbound outreach, onboarding, and enablement for high-potential sellers
  • Cultivate long-term relationships with strategic sellers and community leaders

Cross-Functional Go-To-Market Execution

  • Partner with our Account and Partnerships Managers to scale seller engagement and support
  • Collaborate with Category Marketing Managers to architect high-impact launches, moments, and campaigns
  • Represent category needs and insights to Product and Engineering to improve seller tools, features, and platform performance

Category Performance & Analytics

  • Use data to diagnose growth opportunities, identify bottlenecks, and optimize playbooks
  • Track supply, engagement, retention, and revenue trends and adjust strategies in real time
  • Surface actionable insights to Growth leadership and cross-functional stakeholders

Culture & Community Leadership

  • Act as the platform’s representative within your category’s ecosystem
  • Engage deeply with community norms, vernacular, and cultural drivers to inform both strategy and execution
  • Champion creator and seller needs internally to ensure authentic, category-led growth

About you

  • Experienced GTM / Growth Operator: 5+ years in business development, partnerships, category management, or marketplace growth roles; experience in consumer platforms or two-sided marketplaces preferred
  • Strategic Thinker + Doer: Comfortable defining vision while executing in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Relationship-Driven: Able to build trust quickly with sellers, creators, and internal partners
  • Data Fluent: Makes decisions informed by data and measures what matters
  • Community Minded: Understands cultural nuance, category subcultures, and trends that drive engagement

Nice to Have

  • Existing network within the assigned category (e.g., sneaker resellers, influencer communities, boutique shops)
  • Marketplace experience across both supply and demand sides
  • Experience with creator monetization platforms, community-driven commerce, or enthusiast ecosystems
  • Comfort with CRM tools, sales pipelines, analytics dashboards, and seller performance metrics

Why This Role Matters

As one of the first Category Managers supporting this new commerce initiative, you will:

  • Set the playbook for how categories scale on an emerging platform
  • Shape how StockX engages sellers, creators, and communities at scale
  • Build the foundation of a repeatable, category-centric GTM / Growth engine that expands into new verticals

This role is both strategic and entrepreneurial, with meaningful ownership and the opportunity to influence the trajectory of a high-potential new product.

title: Principal Competitive Intelligence Manager
description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. 

6sense Product Marketing

Principal Competitive Intelligence Manager

Competitive Intelligence & Win/Loss

Team: Product Marketing
Reports to: VP, Product Marketing
Level: Principal  

About the Role

The market we compete in is being redrawn in real time. Point data providers are moving up the stack. Workflow and enrichment tools are repositioning as operating systems. Buyers are assembling their own stacks from components that used to be bought as a platform. Knowing what each competitor shipped last quarter is table stakes — the job is understanding what the pattern means and what we should do about it.

This role owns competitive intelligence and win/loss for 6sense. It sits on the Product Marketing team and exists so that our positioning, our roadmap conversations and our field enablement are built on evidence rather than assumption. You will be the person the company turns to when there is a disagreement about why we win, why we lose, and who we are actually competing against.

This is a senior individual contributor seat. The work is research, synthesis and judgment — and the willingness to tell the company something it would rather not hear, with the evidence to back it up.

What You'll Own

  • The win/loss program, end to end. Interviews, coding, synthesis and the readouts that go to product and executive leadership. Not administering a program — making it the thing people trust when they disagree.

  • Competitive positioning and differentiation. The evidence behind our claims about where we are stronger, and the honesty about where we are not. You partner with the pillar PMMs so competitive insight shapes positioning rather than trailing it.

  • Structural market analysis. How buyers are assembling their stacks, where substitution is happening, which categories are converging, and what that means for us eighteen months out.

  • Field enablement for competitive situations. Battlecards, objection handling, trap-setting questions and talk tracks that hold up in a live deal rather than in a deck.

  • Claims discipline for competitive material. Sourcing every competitive number we put in front of a customer, and saying no to the ones we cannot stand behind.

  • Competitive monitoring and alerting, including ownership of the tooling and of what reaches the field versus what stays internal.

  • Input to roadmap, pricing and packaging, and analyst relations. Competitive evidence should shape what we build and how we price, not only how we sell.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in competitive intelligence, product marketing or research-heavy go-to-market roles in B2B SaaS.

  • Hands-on win/loss experience. Designing the program, running the interviews and coding the results — not reading someone else's summary.

  • The ability to run primary research and be honest about what the data does and does not support. Small samples are useful; presenting them as more than they are is not.

  • Strong synthesis and writing. An executive should be able to read your analysis and know what to do differently.

  • Comfort presenting uncomfortable findings to product and executive audiences, and holding them under pushback.

  • Fluency with the B2B SaaS buyer, ideally in martech, RevTech, sales intelligence or data platforms.

  • Working knowledge of AI and agentic tooling — enough to evaluate what a competitor has actually shipped versus announced.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with competitive intelligence and research tooling (Klue, Gong, Dovetail or equivalent).

  • Analyst relations exposure with Gartner or Forrester.

  • Background in or adjacent to ABM, intent data, GTM intelligence or revenue platforms.

  • Experience building a competitive intelligence function rather than inheriting one.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, win/loss is a program leaders act on rather than a report they receive; we know with evidence why we win and lose, by competitor and by segment; the field has competitive material that holds up in a live deal; and every competitive claim we make in market has a source behind it.

  • Collaborative energy. You work smoothly across teams and time zones, and make alignment feel easy.
  • Insight-driven decisions. You let data guide you while keeping the attendee experience at the center.

Event planning & coordination

  • Partner with the Events Team and Demand Gen to define goals, audiences, formats, and success metrics specific to EMEA markets

  • Partner with Content and Product Marketing to adapt or build webinar content that lands with EMEA audiences

  • Collaborate with Demand Gen, Marketing Ops & Sales to ensure EMEA lead capture, routing, and follow-up happen correctly and quickly
  • Manage attendee communication throughout the event lifecycle

Performance & optimization

  • Share insights and recommendations to continually improve ROI and attendee experience across the region
  • Maintain documentation, templates, and repeatable workflows that make running EMEA events smoother and more scalable

What success looks like

  • Engagement growth: Attendance and engagement steadily increase across EMEA field events and webinars
  • Sales alignment: EMEA Sales and Marketing feel tightly connected and supported by event-driven pipeline
  • Sharper insights: You surface insights that help the program get sharper, smarter, and more efficient over time
  • Better playbooks: EMEA-specific playbooks, templates, and processes get better and help the team move faster

What we're looking for

You're a hands-on, highly organized marketer who loves building great experiences and understands how events translate into revenue. You're comfortable owning a region end to end - you stay grounded under pressure, thrive in a distributed environment, and enjoy the cross-market collaboration required to make EMEA events exceptional.

  • Based in the UK or Ireland (London or Dublin ideal)
  • 4+ years in event marketing within B2B SaaS
  • Experience running in-person events across formats (field events, hosted experiences, conferences), ideally across multiple EMEA markets
  • Experience running webinars, and real excitement about doing both: a busy in-person calendar plus about one webinar a month
  • Strong project management skills - you juggle timelines, tasks, and teams (and time zones) with ease
  • Experience collaborating with Sales and supporting event-driven follow-up
  • Comfortable with marketing automation tools (Customer.io, Marketo, etc.) and Salesforce
  • Familiarity with webinar platforms (Livestorm, Zoom, Sequel) and event management tools
  • Understanding of lead capture, UTMs, and event pipeline attribution
  • Ability to partner with Rev/Marketing Ops to troubleshoot data flows and ensure clean reporting
  • Comfortable with 15%+ travel

Compensation & Benefits

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

title: Account Executive, SLED (Sacramento only)
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

About the Role

Cybercrime doesn't wait for anyone to catch up to it, and neither do we. Abnormal AI is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to join our SLED team, selling behavioral AI security solutions into large, complex State, Local, and Education agencies within a defined territory.

We didn't bolt AI onto old security tools. We built our platform from AI up, to catch the human-targeted attacks that legacy tools miss, and public sector organizations need that protection as much as anyone.

The ideal candidate is local to the Sacramento area and brings experience selling cybersecurity solutions into large public sector environments, particularly Enterprise-level SLED organizations, along with:

  • Proven hunter focused on selling to large state and local government agencies, with a disciplined approach to early pipeline development and prospecting.
  • Skilled at leveraging all five demand generation pillars: AE prospecting, SDRs, marketing, channel partnerships, and customer referrals.
  • Strong qualifier with the ability to uncover public sector pain points and map them to compelling, value-driven solutions.
  • Effective presenter who tailors demos and messaging to resonate with government stakeholders and address their specific challenges.
  • Process-oriented with a consistent sales methodology and strong time management skills to manage multiple deals efficiently.
  • Data-disciplined, maintaining accurate and up-to-date account and opportunity data across systems.
  • Experienced in building business cases that quantify ROI and value for diverse public sector audiences, including IT, procurement, and leadership.
  • Knowledge sharer who captures and organizes customer insights and lessons learned to support team learning.
  • Skilled at guiding public sector customers through complex internal buying processes, including procurement and RFP cycles.
  • Resilient and resourceful, with a strong track record of success in early-stage environments.
  • Effective at leveraging internal teams such as Sales Engineering, Marketing, BDRs, Product, and Customer Success to drive results in the SLED space.

What You Will Do

  • Sell Abnormal AI solutions to large Enterprise SLED agencies with a mandate to overachieve new annual recurring revenue quota, not just hit it.
  • Run the full deal cycle in your accounts: first conversation, technical evaluation, contract signature, and the upsell conversations that follow once they're a customer.
  • Prospect and build new business opportunities to keep your pipeline ahead of target.
  • Sell a platform that's actively expanding underneath you: what started as email security now covers identity, AI security, and insider threat, giving you more surface area to bring value to every agency.
  • Partner with Customer Success to protect timely renewals and surface expansion opportunities.
  • Keep your data sharp across Salesforce, Highspot, and Close Plan, because accurate pipeline is how the whole team plans and wins.
  • Be the customer's advocate inside Abnormal, working with Sales Engineering, Product, and Marketing to get the right things prioritized so more revenue closes, faster.

Must Haves

  • Enterprise SLED Account Hunter: 8+ years of direct (not overlay) enterprise sales experience prospecting and closing large, complex SLED accounts.
  • A proven track record of both closing new account logos and growing existing accounts through cross-sell and upsell within the State of California.
  • Negotiation skill that holds up against large organizations and complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • A track record to back it up: consistent over-quota performance, ideally top 5% of your sales org.
  • Technical fluency across security, email, cloud, and AI, enough to hold your own in a conversation with a security or IT leader.
  • Cybersecurity or security-adjacent SaaS sales experience, selling subscription software to CISOs and security personnel.
  • A builder's mindset: you've thrived somewhere early-stage, an underdog, or up against bigger incumbents, and you know how to build territory with limited resources.
  • Comfort selling within a company that's still writing its next chapter. We're growing 40%+ year over year, protecting more than 4,500 customers including over 25% of the Fortune 500, and expanding fast from email into identity, AI security, and insider threat. That means more to sell, more to learn, and more room to make your mark than a mature market leader can offer.

title: Brand Designer
description:
Headquarters: Remote (United States)

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale is looking for an experienced Brand Designer to help bring our brand to life across every customer touchpoint. You'll create thoughtful, high-quality creative that helps people understand our products, builds trust with technical audiences, and supports some of our most important marketing initiatives.

This role reports to the Team Lead and partners closely with Brand, Growth, Web, Content, Product Marketing, and Developer Relations. You'll own projects from concept through execution, contribute to the evolution of our design systems, and help us scale creative output without sacrificing quality.

We're looking for someone who cares deeply about craft, thrives in collaborative environments but is able to work autonomously while requiring minimal direction, and enjoys solving complex communication problems through thoughtful design.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own brand design projects from creative brief through final delivery with limited guidance
  • Design high-quality creative assets across web, campaigns, events, social media, presentations, product marketing, and internal communications
  • Apply and thoughtfully extend Tailscale's visual identity across new formats and channels
  • Create reusable templates, design systems, and creative processes that improve consistency and efficiency
  • Partner closely with Growth, Web, Product Marketing, Content, and Developer Relations to deliver cohesive customer experiences
  • Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders and thoughtfully incorporate feedback
  • Balance multiple projects while consistently delivering polished, production-ready work
  • Contribute ideas that improve the quality, scalability, and effectiveness of our creative work

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience in brand, marketing, or visual design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional design foundations: color theory, accessibility, typography, layout, and storytelling
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud 
  • Experience designing for digital marketing, websites, campaigns, and brand systems
  • Strong understanding of production-ready design across digital and print
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities with minimal oversight
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with marketers, writers, developers, and other designers
  • Strong attention to detail with a high bar for quality and consistency
  • Comfortable giving and receiving constructive design feedback
  • Actively seeks opportunities to refine processes, improve project organization, and make collaboration more effective through thoughtful recommendations.
  • Curious by nature, with a desire to learn about the technical world of networking.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for B2B SaaS or developer-focused products
  • Familiarity with design systems and component libraries
  • Motion design or animation experience
  • Illustration or icon design experience
  • Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and web design constraints
  • Experience supporting experimentation, conversion optimization, or growth marketing initiatives
  • Experience working in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments
  • Experience art-directing or mentoring junior designers

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range
$117,750—$153,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. 
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! 
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. 
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Headquarters: United Kingdom (Remote)

Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

We’re excited to hire someone based in London, where we’re looking to grow our sales presence.

About The Role

Our team is still early in its evolution, operating with a start-up mindset within a scaling company. We're building stronger processes, a clearer operating model, and the foundation for our next stage of growth. We’re looking for someone who wants to help create that future—not just operate within it.

As a Senior Account Executive reporting directly to the Head of Sales, you’ll be a key driver of our outbound engine. You’re a strategic seller who owns the full cycle, thrives on proactive outreach, and isn’t phased by cold calls or pipeline creation. You combine discipline with initiative, independence with collaboration, and urgency with long-term relationship-building.

Your territory spans Mid-Market and Enterprise customers, blending short-cycle and long-cycle opportunities. But make no mistake: outbound is the heartbeat of this role.


Things you will do:

  • Outreach + engagement: contact leads via email, cold calls, conferences, and more. Manage inbound and referral leads.
  • Lead gen + prospecting: research potential customers, generate leads, and build a consistent outbound sales pipeline. Attend industry events and develop connections to drive future sales growth.
  • Qualification + closing: run discovery calls, demos, and follow-ups to qualify and close new customers. Build proposals and RoI cases that convince qualified prospects to buy Listen. Negotiate contract terms when needed.
  • Process improvement: improve our internal sales processes (slides, call scripts, meeting templates, contract terms, CRM workflows, metrics, dashboards, etc.). Run weekly “Sales Review” meetings company-wide to review deals and answer questions.
  • Cross-team work: work with Customer Success, Engineering, and Product to consistently delight customers. Work with our co-founding team on all things sales and revenue-related.

 

What you already bring to the table:

  • 5–8+ years of quota-carrying closing experience in B2B SaaS
  • Experience selling into enterprise or upper mid-market accounts
  • Proven ability to run consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • Track record of closing meaningful deals ($50K–$250K+) and expanding accounts
  • Strong discovery and storytelling skills
  • Comfortable balancing inbound + outbound pipeline generation
  • Highly organized and proactive in managing deals end-to-end

 

*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team, empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.

title: Account Executive, Corporate
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work.

Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless.  That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses.

We’re builders at heart, and we’re looking for builders who want to expand what’s possible in Airtable and what the world can build with it.

As a Corporate Account Executive, you’ll work with a portfolio of SMB and Mid-Market customers across a wide range of verticals and industries. That means the best outcomes rarely come from running a standard playbook. We need someone who finds that energizing, someone curious enough to understand how a complex organization actually operates, disciplined enough to orchestrate complex,multi-threaded sales cycles, and resourceful enough to bring the right people in at the right moment.

If you’re excited by the challenge of turning an initial opportunity into a strategic relationship, navigating increasingly complex deals, and finding new ways for Airtable to create value across an organization, you’ll thrive here. We hire Corporate AEs with growth in mind: you’ll get the exposure, coaching, and increasing deal complexity you need to ramp quickly toward becoming an Enterprise Account Executive.

What you'll do

  • Turn Airtable’s large self-service user base into new business, using existing adoption and proven use cases to uncover and develop high-potential opportunities.
  • Build relationships with leaders across functions and industries, understanding what matters to them and finding opportunities to expand Airtable’s impact as their organizations grow.
  • Own and prioritize your book of business, developing thoughtful account plans and finding your way from an initial champion to stakeholders across the organization.
  • Lead complex sales cycles from first conversation through close, bringing in Customer Success, Solution Engineering, and other partners at the right moments to move opportunities forward.
  • Become a trusted advisor to prospects: understand their business objectives and bring Airtable’s flexibility to life through compelling use cases that show how the platform can solve their problems and transform the way their teams work.

Who you are

  • You bring 1-3 years of quota-carrying closing experience at a technology company
  • You’ve successfully closed deals with mid-market and larger organizations (50-3,000 FTEs), with a track record of hitting or exceeding your sales goals.
  • You can run a structured sales process (e.g., Force Management) with rigor and self-awareness. You know where your deals stand, what needs to happen next, and which stakeholders to bring in at the right moments to move them forward.
  • You’re a strong communicator and relationship builder. You build credibility with business leaders and executives, develop the trust needed to move opportunities forward, and create alignment across g stakeholders at each stage of the sales lifecycle.
  • You’re an adaptable seller. You’re comfortable moving across industries, use cases, and buyer personas, and you know how to make your approach relevant to each.

What we offer

Compensation awarded to successful candidates will vary based on their work location, relevant skills and experience. The on-target earnings range for this role is $182,800 to $238,100 for all office and remote locations.

Our total compensation package also includes the opportunity to receive benefits and may include incentive compensation. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit offerings, please check out Life at Airtable.
